name: shore_water_transition
adaptation_notes_v2: Upgraded renderer: 3-band sand/wash/water is now expressible with shared contour-following bands (step_px=6 <=8, so no constant-x run exceeds C5's 8 px).
bands.sand [28,38] and bands.wash [50,60] are the doc's C2 @720p widths (38 / 60-90) converted to the 512 px authoring canvas; acceptance.C2 targets remain verbatim at @720p.

water.wash + water.foam are masked to the wash band (foam gated to coast band); layer opacities were chosen so the composited pale wash matches the doc's LIT wash #B1B3A3, and water.shallow uses an explicit tint calibrated to the doc's LIT shallow plateau #A8B1AB because this tool has no sun/lighting. A water.deep layer supplies the paired deep sample required by C7. The unlit donor shader RGB [0.1,0.24,0.24] stays verbatim in reference.detail. No acceptance target was changed.
adaptation_notes: Transcribed from shore_water_transition.md section 3 (render spec JSON); no acceptance number changed.
Renderer requires water.sheet; diffusewaves2 is the existing water sheet convention (app/assets/terrain/water_png/diffusewaves2.png).

Renderer accepts a single reference image/box; reference.crop_box_src_px [340,238,420,272] from maxresdefault_1.jpg is used. All band/transition/donor-shader numbers are preserved under reference.detail and acceptance.
The doc's reference object has no image/box keys, so they were derived from its own source and crop_box_src_px fields; no new band geometry was invented.

detail.foam: pale gray-tan wash band (not white); donor procedural nautic()+particles() in coast band
